'''Cube v7 + Objectives Draft''' is a draft format on [[GEMP]] (code <code>c7obj_draft</code>) with a deck size of 40 cards. GEMP's draft list points this type to <code>/draft/cubeObj7Draft.json</code>.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="drafts" />

== Deck size ==
{| class="wikitable"
! Default deck size on [[GEMP]]
| 40 cards
|}
The GEMP format definition sets a deck size of 40 cards.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="lib-ec48dc19" /> The Players Committee GEMP code has the same draft definition, but it names the <code>cube</code> format, which that code sets to 45 cards.<ref name="pc-draft">[https://github.com/PlayersCommittee/gemp-swccg-public/blob/5e26dd19cc700adbf77de53e0d7b89720c94f03e/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/resources/draft/cubeObj7Draft.json cubeObj7Draft.json], GEMP source code (PlayersCommittee/gemp-swccg-public, commit 5e26dd19), GitHub. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261021130038/https://swccg.com/snapshots/github/PlayersCommittee/gemp-swccg-public/5e26dd19/cubeObj7Draft.json.html Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="pc-gemp">[https://github.com/PlayersCommittee/gemp-swccg-public/blob/5e26dd19cc700adbf77de53e0d7b89720c94f03e/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/resources/swccgFormats.json swccgFormats.json], GEMP source code (PlayersCommittee/gemp-swccg-public, commit 5e26dd19), GitHub. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261021130403/https://swccg.com/snapshots/github/PlayersCommittee/gemp-swccg-public/5e26dd19/swccgFormats.json.html Internet Archive].</ref> The differences are listed at [[GEMP draft and cube products#Differences from the Players Committee GEMP|GEMP draft and cube products]].
